title: Transformer Training FLOPs Estimator
seoDescription: Estimate one training step from forward matrix multiplications and a supplied forward attention cost.
description:
Estimate the total floating-point operations (FLOPs) required for one autoregressive training step from parameter count, token throughput, and attention complexity.

**Mathematical Formulation:**

$$
\text{FLOPs} = 6 \cdot N \cdot T + \text{AttnFLOPs}
$$

**Step-by-Step Implementation:**
1. Compute feedforward and projection matrix multiplication FLOPs as 6 * N * T.
2. Calculate quadratic attention FLOPs from supplied per-token attention cost.
3. Sum matrix multiplication and attention operations to produce total FLOPs per training step.

**Returns:** Integer representing total floating-point operations.
